steps: Browse r/DesignJobs filtered by the [Hiring] flair (136 recent hiring-topic posts indexed) for design work matching your skills.
Read each post's brief, budget, and contact instructions (example live post: '[For Hire] Graphic and Brand Designer ... $40/hr').
Reply or DM with your portfolio, rate, and availability.
Agree on scope, pay, and payment method in writing before starting.
catches: Pay is set per poster and varies wildly; nothing is guaranteed.
No escrow or payment protection — non-payment risk is entirely yours.
Scam risk (fake clients, advance-fee schemes); never pay to get hired.
202k members compete for the same hiring posts; logo/branding posts attract the most competition.
Anonymous posters — verify legitimacy via account history before doing work.
biggest_catch: No payment protection and no guaranteed work: every dollar depends on a deal you negotiate yourself with an anonymous poster.
eligibility: Free Reddit account (13+ per Reddit's terms); open worldwide.
timing: New [Hiring] posts appear continuously; reply on your own schedule.
